leads.look: Young adult Kosalan man in forest exile: matted dark hair bound, uncut beard stubble optional, taut lean body, bark-cloth and simple kshatriya string, bow always near. Face is calm, not cute. Ink-print graphic novel, not cel-shaded manhwa.
leads.voice: Few words. Measured. Refuses without cruelty. Does not sermonize mid-fight.

relationships.note: Trusts him to hold the line; does not mock his temper.
Names the refusal clearly; does not toy with her desire.

costume_variants.look: same cloth, string drawn, dust and sweat

iconography: tilak modest if present — not glow

leads.look: Young adult woman, dark hair in a practical forest knot, sun-worn, simple sari or bark-cloth, no palace jewelry in Panchavati except a few pieces she later drops. Face reads intelligence and want, not doll-cuteness.
leads.voice: Direct. She asks. She insists on the deer. She refuses Ravana in full sentences.

relationships.note: Desire and trust; she is not a silent prize.
Sharp when she sends him after Rama; not a shrew caricature.

costume_variants.look: same cloth disordered; jewels used as trail not decoration

iconography: one recognizable necklace/earring set for the jewel drop

leads.look: Slightly younger than Rama, similar exile kit, shorter fuse in the eyes, bow or blade at hand. Same graphic-novel ink language as Rama so they read as kin, not clones — sharper jaw, less stillness.
leads.voice: Faster than Rama. Insults land. He can be ugly in the mutilation beat without becoming a cartoon sadist.

relationships.note: Obeys; resents being left as doorman.
The insult is his; own it.

costume_variants.look: matching exile cloth, distinct scarf or arm-wrap so he is not Rama

leads.role: rakshasi / desire / messenger of the war
leads.look_whole: Adult rakshasi who can wear a beautiful human-seeming form: dark hair, hungry mouth, forest jewelry, body that is sexual without pin-up posing. Not a monster-of-the-week. Desire is the point.
leads.look_wounded: Same person after the insult: nose and ears cut — blood, shock, ruined face held as consequence, not a money shot. Keep her eyes. Keep her hair. The wound is a continuity lock for ep 2–4.
leads.look: See costume_variants whole vs wounded. Default sheet is whole.
leads.voice: Frank desire, then rage. In Lanka she performs the wound and the wanting of Sita for Ravana's ear.

relationships.note: She uses humiliation to move him.
She brings him to die in ep 3.

costume_variants.look: same clothes, ruined midface, blood dried then fresh as needed

iconography: midface wound after ep 2 is mandatory
never_do: reduce her to comic hag only

leads.look_king: Mature rakshasa king: ten heads are a design problem — prefer one primary head plus implied others (crown of faces, or nine in shadow/relief) so the reader can lock ONE face. Broad, jeweled, court-red and gold, not a Halloween mask. Pride in the shoulders.
leads.look_ascetic: Same primary face, stripped: ochre or bark robe, matted hair, water-pot, smaller body language. The reader must still see Ravana. Sita must not.
leads.look: King form unless episode says ascetic.
leads.voice: Court: measured appetite and insult-to-honor. Ascetic: borrowed humility that slips.

relationships.note: Her wound is his pretext and his hunger's door.
Want is political and sexual; staging stays adult, not porn.

leads.look: Older, thinner rakshasa than Ravana; fear in the posture. Deer form: luminous gold, too perfect, wrong for a forest — magic that looks like a trap.
leads.voice: Counsel first: do not do this. Then obedience. Dying cry copies Rama's timbre (dramatized).

relationships.note: He has seen Rama's arrow before.

costume_variants.look: lean rakshasa, Lanka or forest edge

iconography: gold that does not belong in Dandaka
never_do: heroic last stand that steals Jatayu's beat

leads.look: Enormous aged raptor, scarred, kingly not mascot. Wings as landscape. Wounded: one wing ruined, blood in feathers, still speaking.
leads.voice: Old. Costly. Names Ravana. No cute animal comic relief.

relationships.note: Ep 10 is testimony, not a fight he can win twice.
He fails; that is the point.

iconography: scale: he is bigger than the chariot's pride

supporting.look: War-form rakshasa, armor and mace, not a copy of Ravana's face.
never_do: steal the episode from Rama's identity test

supporting.look: Paired with Khara; distinct helmet or mark so crowd shots can pick two.
